transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, mostly I just... I don't really feel like myself anymore. I've stopped doing pretty much everything I used to enjoy. I used to go hiking, I was coaching, playing my guitar... but I just stopped all of it. I don't even call people back these days. 

Some days, I just sit in my small rental for hours. I know there are things I need to get done, but... I just can't seem to make myself start.
Do you still find pleasure in the things you do, even if you're not doing them as often?

No, not really. Like I was just saying, I really just don't feel like myself. I don't get anything out of those things anymore. 

That's why I stopped the coaching and the hiking. If I try to pick up the guitar now, it's just... I don't know, it's just wood and strings. There's no feeling there. It's just blank. So I just end up sitting in the rental. I know I should get up and do things, even the things I used to like, but without any enjoyment in it... I just can't make myself start.
Do you feel sad most of the time?

No, I wouldn't say I feel sad. I know what sadness is, and it's not that. I don't feel down or... or feel like crying or anything like that. It's really just what I said before. It's just blank. I don't really feel much of anything at all.
Do you still enjoy eating or looking forward to meals?

Not really. I mean, I eat because I know I have to, but... I don't care what it is. I definitely don't look forward to it. It's just... it's just fuel, I guess. It all pretty much tastes the same to me now, so there's no real enjoyment there either.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns?
No, not really. My sleep is pretty much the same as it's always been. I just go to bed and sleep my normal hours, and then I wake up. I haven't noticed any changes with that.
Do you feel tired most of the time?
No, not really. I don't feel physically tired. My energy is... it's fine, I guess. I'm not exhausted or anything like that. I just feel normal in that way, so no, I haven't noticed feeling tired.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been about a year and two months ago. I'd say that's when things really started unraveling... right around the time I moved into this smaller rental, just after my divorce.
Do you often feel worthless or guilty about things?

No, not really. I don't feel guilty about anything. I mean... things happen, like with the marriage ending, but I don't sit around feeling worthless. I know I'm a capable guy. So, no, I don't have those kinds of thoughts about myself.
Have you had any thoughts about death or wanting to die?

No, I haven't. I mean... I don't want to die. I haven't had any thoughts like that at all. Things have been a lot to deal with lately, sure, but I'm definitely not looking to end my life or anything. So, no, nothing like that.
Have you experienced any significant weight loss or gain since you started feeling this way?

No, I haven't. My weight has... well, it's stayed pretty steady, actually. I haven't noticed any big drops or gaining a lot of weight. My clothes still fit the same as they did a year ago, so... no, no real changes there.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than you used to, or have people told you that you seem slower?
No, I don't think so. I... I move around just fine. Nobody has told me I seem slower or anything like that. I feel like I'm going at the exact same speed I always have, so no, I haven't noticed that.
Do you think your movements or reactions seem slower or more sluggish to others, even if you don't feel that way yourself?

No, I really don't think so. I mean, my coworkers haven't mentioned anything, and in my line of work, you kind of have to be on your toes. So if I was moving slower or... or reacting late, someone would have definitely pointed it out by now. But no one has said a word.
Have you ever thought that you'd be better off dead?
No, I haven't. I mean... things can get overwhelming sometimes, sure, but I've never wanted to die or anything like that. I don't have thoughts about being better off dead, no.
Do you feel like you're resting or sitting more often than you used to?

Yeah, I do. Mostly I just don't feel like myself anymore. I used to be pretty active, but I've stopped hiking, coaching... I even stopped playing my guitar and calling people back. Some days I just sit in that small rental for hours. I know there are things I need to get done, but I just... I can't make myself start. So, yes, I am definitely sitting a lot more than I used to.
Do you feel like you're fidgeting or restless more often than you used to?

No, I don't think so. I mean, like I said, I've just been sitting a lot more. I don't really feel restless or like I need to move around. It's more just... staying in one place. So, no, not fidgeting or anything like that.
Has your feeling of emptiness and lack of enjoyment in activities been consistent over the past year, or have you had periods where you felt somewhat better?

It's been pretty consistent, I guess. I mean, it's not like I have days where I suddenly feel like my old self again or want to go out and do things. It's just... it's just been this way for a while now. I haven't really had any periods where it lifted or I felt better. It's just flat, all the time.
Would you say this feeling of emptiness and lack of enjoyment has been mild, moderate, or severe for you over the past year?

I'd have to say severe. It's... it just completely wiped out everything I used to care about. Like I mentioned, I don't do any of my old activities anymore, and it just feels heavy all the time. So, yeah, definitely severe.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or making decisions?

Not really. I mean... I haven't exactly been doing much that requires a lot of focus lately, since I mostly just sit there. But no, my mind works fine when I need it to. I don't have any trouble making choices or paying attention to things. It's just that I don't really care to do much, not that I can't concentrate on it.
Have you experienced any unusual thoughts or heard any voices that others couldn't hear?

Yeah, I have actually. Um... sometimes I hear these short voices, kind of like radio chatter. It happens even when my work scanner is completely turned off. They usually warn me about things... like they'll tell me someone is inside the house, or that I'm being watched. 

And... well, sometimes I see things too. Just a shadow moving past the hallway at my house. It bothers me because I'll see it right after I've already cleared every room and made sure the place is completely empty. So, yeah, I guess I have been experiencing that.
